<challenge>
Create an unforgettable landing page for a fictional premium brand called **Elysian**.

Use these four images to shape the visual world of the experience:

- https://code.melvynx.dev/elysian-classical-surreal-still-life.png
- https://codelynx.mlvcdn.com/uploads/2026-07-13/2026-07-13-greco-roman-scholarly-landscape.png
- https://codelynx.mlvcdn.com/uploads/2026-07-13/2026-07-13-vibrant-mountain-river-valley.png
- https://codelynx.mlvcdn.com/uploads/2026-07-13/2026-07-13-golden-temple-starry-night.png

The experience should feel imaginative, editorial, luxurious, and slightly surreal. It should make a strong impression immediately and reveal more personality through interaction and movement.
</challenge>

<creative-freedom>
Always prioritize creativity. Make bold, unexpected decisions and develop an original concept rather than following familiar landing-page conventions.

You have complete creative freedom over the story, copy, layout, typography, colors, transitions, and interactions. Use the images in whatever way creates the strongest experience: crop them, layer them, sequence them, transform them, or make them part of the interaction.

Do not place the images into ordinary rectangular sections and call the page finished. Treat them as raw material for a coherent visual world. Avoid generic startup layouts and generic component-library aesthetics.
</creative-freedom>

<delivery>
Build the complete experience in the current repository. It must work beautifully on desktop and mobile.

Do not explain the design before building it. Make the creative decisions yourself and deliver the most original, polished result you can.
</delivery>

Work only inside the current working directory. Do not read, list, search, or edit files outside the current working directory. Treat it as a standalone project root.

Use pnpm exclusively if dependency installation or package scripts are needed. Do not use npm.
Set the browser title and the primary visible title to your model name, using only identity information already available to you. Add nothing else to either title.
Run the relevant checks yourself. Do not edit files outside the current working directory.

The **Elysian** digital experience (*Maison d’Alchimie, Reliques Architecturales & Traités Surréalistes*) is built and verified in the current repository.

### Key Architectural & Interactive Highlights

1. **Chapter I — Le Cabinet des Mondes Impossibles (`src/components/HeroWunderkammer.tsx`)**
   - **Browser & Primary Visible Title**: Set strictly to `Gemini 4 Argon` (`index.html` and `<h1>`).
   - **Dual-Reality Ocular Loupe**: Layers the four artworks inside a custom-clipped SVG sanctuary portal (`Arche`, `Serrure`, `Oracle`, `Fronton`). Moving your cursor (or letting the autonomous Lissajous orbit run) refracts a second chosen world (*Le Naos des Étoiles*, *Le Traité Vésuvien*, *L’Arcadie de Safran*, or *Le Cabinet du Paradoxe*) through a customizable brass iris.
   - **Orbiting Cut-Out Satellites**: Four non-rectangular cropped fragments (vesica, chalice, octagram, arch) orbit the rotating astrolabe ring with live SVG constellation threads.

2. **Chapter II — L’Anatomie du Paradoxe (`src/components/CabinetDissection.tsx`)**
   - **Interactive Specimen Excavation**: Dissects the high-resolution surrealist still life into 6 interactive coordinate relics (*L’Enclos Alpin*, *L’Urne au Méandre*, *Le Parthénon des Brumes*, *L’Oracle Couché & Le Buste*, *La Colonne Cannelée Rose*, *Le Mortier de Poudre & Codices*).
   - **Magnified Cut-Out Medallions & Plongée Oculaire (2.2×)**: Clicking any coordinate pin or sculpted medallion pans the camera across the canvas, extracts the fragment into a custom geometric mask, displays its olfactory accords and pigment hex swatches, and lets you seal the specimen into your personal monograph.

3. **Chapter III — Le Prisme des Horizons (`src/components/TriptychMorphStage.tsx`)**
   - **Three Optical Instruments**:
     - **Colonnes Cannelées (Lenticular Louvers)**: 12 vertical fluted slices that interleave and tilt in 3D as you scrub or glide across the stage.
     - **Anneaux d’Astrolabe (Concentric Mandala)**: Four counter-rotating concentric painting rings that align and fracture according to the pendulum angle.
     - **Paravent d’Arches (3D Folding Screen)**: Four hinged classical sanctuary panels that expand on selection.

4. **Chapter IV — Les Quatre Reliquaires & Alambic d’Assemblage (`src/components/AlchemyComposer.tsx`)**
   - Presents the four numbered Maison editions (*Paradoxe de Paros*, *Cendre de Vésuve*, *Vallée de Safran*, *Naos des Étoiles*) as multi-layered sculptural totems, paired with a live **Alembic Transmutation Workbench** where four proportion sliders dynamically composite all four paintings into a personal wax-sealed emblem.

5. **Chapter V — Le Seuil du Naos & Monographe Personnel (`src/components/NaosPortalFinale.tsx`)**
   - Dilates the golden Corinthian temple pediment to reveal the starry cella, tracks all 6 excavated specimens, and includes a Web Audio API Pythagorean harmonic soundscape toggle (`src/utils/harmonicAudio.ts`) plus 4 live atmospheric color themes in the header (`src/components/SurrealHeader.tsx`).
